subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public security-policy taxonomy should `before_tool_call` expose for action classification and provenance?
rationale: The fields would become public Plugin SDK security inputs, and automation cannot safely choose between enum categories, composable capability flags, or a simplified provenance shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Unified Hook Facts
options.body: Define one additive hook contract that combines action/capability facts with a bounded, documented provenance shape and aligns with the sibling capability-descriptor issue.

options.title: Defer To Broader Security Matrix
options.body: Keep this issue blocked until broader runtime safety classification and provenance proposals settle the taxonomy.

options.title: External Content Only
options.body: Limit near-term work to the narrower external-content provenance concept and leave action categories for a later descriptor contract.

recommendation.title: Design Unified Hook Facts
recommendation.body: Define one additive hook contract that combines action/capability facts with a bounded, documented provenance shape and aligns with the sibling capability-descriptor issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent generic host-hook/trusted-policy seams this public hook contract would extend.
